audit.why: Lane reads as Qiyana-favoured pre-6, flipping at 6 and again at two items — matches packet levelChart and diff EVEN 5.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases all say 'Skill' while content win[] and packet levelChart name Qiyana/Malzahar per row; phases[4] and phases[6] whys describe Qiyana winning stages Malzahar wins.
audit.why: Two layers must agree; whys must match the side.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match content/packet; phases[4] and phases[6] whys rewritten to Malzahar-side facts (Nether Grasp at 6, Zhonya's+suppress late).

audit.whatIsWrong: Malzahar's passive is repeatedly called a 'spell shield' named 'Malefic Void Shield'. Riot: passive is Void Shift — massive damage reduction and CC immunity broken by damage/CC, not a spell shield that eats one ability. Also Q silence (6s CD) and E execute-pressure from missingInteractions were unstated in cooldowns text.
audit.why: Kit authority: Void Shift; Q Call of the Void silences; R Nether Grasp 140/110/80s point-and-click suppression, QSS-cleansable.
audit.corrected: Void Shift named correctly in wants.you[1], wants.foe[1], whys[3], spikes[0].text; Q silence and real R cooldown folded into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.

edits.before: His passive Void Shield popped by a poke before you commit
edits.after: His passive Void Shift popped by a poke before you commit

edits.before: To keep his spell shield up to eat your first Q or E
edits.after: To keep Void Shift up so your opening hit is blunted

edits.before: Through levels 4-5 you keep punishing every popped spell shield with committed all-ins.
edits.after: Through levels 4-5 you keep punishing every broken Void Shift with committed all-ins.

edits.before: Pre-6 Malzahar is a farming turret with no self-peel, so this is your window. Bait or pop his passive Malefic Void Shield with a stray Q Edge of Ixtal or an auto, then commit E Audacity into the enchanted Q while his spell shield is on cooldown. His only defence is E Malefic Visions damage and W Voidlings, neither of which stops a committed combo, so you can chunk or kill him repeatedly before he hits 6.
edits.after: Pre-6 Malzahar is a farming turret with no self-peel, so this is your window. Break his passive Void Shift — heavy damage reduction and CC immunity — with a stray Q or auto first, then commit E Audacity into the enchanted Q while it is down. His only defence is E Malefic Visions damage and W Voidlings, neither of which stops a committed combo, so you can chunk or kill him repeatedly before he hits 6.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Terrashape (element swap) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is a 140/110/80s point-and-click suppress — once he burns it you own a two-minute window; never step up solo while Void Shift and R are both up. - Call of the Void silences on a 6s cooldown; trade the moment the portals fire. - Your W swap is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Grass-Q from stealth, E-ice the answer, auto, walk back into the hedge — terrain trades he experiences as ambush weather.
edits.after: When he steps up to refresh Malefic Visions, E in and ice-Q the root — it buys the full auto string before he escapes.

edits.before: E-ing in with no element loaded and his CC banked — Qiyana without terrain prep is a dagger doing improv.
edits.after: A wasted Terrashape leaves your next trade element-less for its 7s cooldown — load the element before you commit.

edits.before: Supreme Display online — any fight near a wall is a stun lottery you rigged. Hug terrain like rent depends on it.
edits.after: Nether Grasp online flips it — the point-and-click suppress deletes your dash-in, so bait the R before you commit.

edits.before: Late Qiyana flanks through her own R: shockwave the objective wall, string the stunned, and vanish into grass.
edits.after: Two items add Zhonya's to his suppress — one R into stasis eats your whole combo, so flank a softer target late.

notes: Content win[] already matched packet levelChart, so side edits are unpaired by design (win before==after would be a no-op). Malzahar passive corrected from 'spell shield / Malefic Void Shield' to Void Shift (damage reduction + CC immunity). QSS-vs-suppress claims retained (QSS removes Nether Grasp suppression — long-standing behaviour, Medium confidence, not in kit text).
